title: Why you shouldn't water cool your PC
summary: Linus Tech Tips argues that big air coolers beat AIO liquid coolers for most PCs. They compare quietness and temperatures, using the Noctua NH-U12A as the example.
why: HN cites it as evidence that a good air cooler matches pricier liquid cooling, so water cooling is often unnecessary.

quote.text: Good air coolers match the performance of twice as expensive AIOs
